svg.title: MacBook Pro 14-inch (M5 Pro, PROLED XDR) — silver
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. US catalog, 2026-11-20. Reference SKU: MJ2G4LL/A (Silver, standard display). 14.2-inch tandem OLED touchscreen; native 3024 × 1986 px. The circular cutout represents the camera, not the expanded Dynamic Island UI. Apple display reference (1094 × 664 px), front elevation: deck/lid/display widths ≈ 1072/912/884 px; lid top y=4, display bottom y≈599, deck starts y≈617, metal ends y≈655, feet end y≈662 (exclusive ends). Native aspect retained; lid meets deck at the visible seam. Four rounded screen corners; centered round camera opening estimated inside the visible pill, not a mask for the software island. Corner radii, lens, recess and underside curves are approximations; feet clearance included without drawing the feet. Finish swatches are illustrative. Sources: https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro/proled-xdr-display/specs/; https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-pro-proled-xdr; https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/10/apple-unveils-groundbreaking-macbook-pro-with-proled-xdr-display/; https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-pro/proled-xdr-display/b/images/specs/display_14_inch__dj3gn87hqg02_large_2x.jpg; https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-pro/proled-xdr-display/b/images/specs/macbook_pro_proled_14_inch__cvrly0a7oqc2_large_2x.jpg
